title: New Hampshire Motor Speedway

services.name: Track Rental
services.desc: On Nov. 2, 2007, O. Bruton Smith, founder, chairman & chief executive officer of Speedway Motorsports, agreed to purchase New Hampshire International Speedway from Bob & Gary Bahre. Closing documents were completed on Jan. 11, 2008, finalizing the purchase of the newly renamed New Hampshire Motor Speedway (NHMS). The speedway, which opened in 1990, is located about one hour north of Boston in Loudon, N.H. According to the latest census numbers, the population within 200 miles of the speedway is more than 18 million people. services.desc: Centrally located in not only New Hampshire, but New England as well, New Hampshire Motor Speedway is the perfect spot to host your next corporate event. Whether you need space to conduct a class or seminar, covered open-air space or a luxury suite, NHMS has the spot for you. The newly remodeled Media Center is located inside "The Magic Mile" & is a great location for meetings & trainings & equipped with small breakout rooms, private restrooms & audio-visual capabilities. NHMS has two garage locations inside the racetrack. Each garage space has 14 garage bays on each side & is a perfect location for outdoor trade shows, trainings & vehicle launches.
